_doc: Spakarna för stenar i Asset Studio (Smedjans flik Stone), som tools/tree/params.json: spec.* = presetets värden i tools/props/props.json (skickas som params till make_prop.py), recipe.* = receptets fält. scale och tall är multiplikatorer på storleken och höjden, så att de fungerar även för presets med intervall (stengrupper, basalt). Texten som visas är på engelska.
label: Stones

params.label: Size
params.help: Scales the stone (and every stone in a group)

params.label: Height
params.help: Flatter or taller than the kind's own shape

params.label: Moss
params.help: Moss on the upward faces (drawn by the material, softly edged)

params.label: Corners
params.help: How many points the stone's hull is built from: few gives big chunky faces, many a rounder stone

params.label: Flat top
params.help: Chance of a flat face on top

params.label: Blocks
params.help: A boulder can be several blocks leaning into each other

params.label: Column sides
params.help: Basalt: the number of sides of each column (0 = an ordinary stone)

params.label: Edge width
params.help: How wide the worn strip along every edge is, as a share of the stone's size

params.label: Face shade
params.help: How much darker the flat faces are than the worn edges (1 = no difference)

params.label: Merge faces (°)
params.help: Neighbouring faces closer than this angle become one face, so wear only shows on real edges
